diagnosis.gap: 15 enrolments below the low end of the expected band (78–118); clicks are inside their band

causes.label: Message and programme mismatch (RR-H05)
causes.detail: Hyderabad Tech Jobs: 6,100 clicks but 2 enrolments (0.03%). Its audience is 71% Hyderabad; the cohort is Warangal

causes.label: Adoption gap
causes.detail: Prof. Lakshmi Narayana and Warangal Youth Forum are confirmed but past their post dates

causes.label: Placement doubt
causes.detail: 22% of comments on job-alert content doubt placement outcomes; Scepticism threshold is 15%

causes.label: Facebook registration drop-off
causes.detail: Group post: 2,900 clicks, 8% registration rate vs 12% campaign average

alerts.text: Hyderabad Tech Jobs: click-through healthy (1.5%) but enrolment rate 0.5% of registrations, below the 4% floor. Treat as message and programme mismatch, not channel failure.
Placement-doubt share at 22% of comments on Instagram (threshold 15%). Consider an alumni testimonial or live Q&A.

moves.title: Get Prof. Lakshmi Narayana and Warangal Youth Forum live by 9 Oct
moves.why: Both are trust anchors for this cohort. Content for the professor is in review; the forum broadcast only needs the tracked card.

moves.title: Move ₹60,000 from Hyderabad Tech Jobs reel 2 to a campus session at KITS Warangal
moves.why: Reel 2 is not yet made. Placement-cell sources convert at 1.4% click-to-enrolment against 0.03% for this creator.

moves.title: Add a second Sai Kiran Reddy post answering placement doubts
moves.why: His first post has the highest enrolment rate on the campaign (7%) and directly addresses the Scepticism theme.

moves.title: Run a live Q&A with Batch 3 alumni on the programme's YouTube
moves.why: Eligibility and schedule are the top two question themes; a live Q&A answers both at once.

versions.note: Accepted move: shifted ₹40,000 from Instagram to WhatsApp placement-cell cards.

threads.title: Why is Warangal engineering graduates behind?

messages.text: Why is Warangal engineering graduates behind?

At the Day 14 checkpoint the campaign had 63 screening enrolments against an expected band of 78–118, while clicks are inside their band. The largest cause (41%) is a message and programme mismatch: Hyderabad Tech Jobs produced 6,100 clicks but only 2 enrolments, and 71% of its audience is in Hyderabad, not Warangal. Two confirmed trust-anchor sources have not posted yet.
